FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.q1: How to find student housing quickly?
FAQ.a1: Use our search engine to filter residences by immediate availability (badge 'Immediate Avail'). When going through a private residence, applications are often processed within 48h, unlike private landlords who can take weeks. Tip: complete your profile 100% to be prioritized.
FAQ.q2: What is the difference between shared flat and coliving?
FAQ.a2: Classic shared flat shares a standard apartment (living room, kitchen). Coliving is designed specifically for community: you have your private studio or room with bathroom, and access hotel services (cleaning, gym, cinema) and XXL common areas for working or socializing.
FAQ.q3: Why choose a residence over a private landlord?
FAQ.a3: For security and simplicity. You sign a standardized lease without abusive clauses. A manager is present on-site for your packages or technical issues. Plus, utilities are often 'all-inclusive' (water, electricity, internet), avoiding end-of-month surprises.
FAQ.a4: Yes, we are directly connected with managers. The displayed price generally includes rent and rental charges. Always check the details on the listing: some 'Premium' services (parking, breakfast) may be extra.
FAQ.q5: Can I visit the housing before booking?
FAQ.a5: Absolutely. You can request a physical or virtual visit (video call) directly from the contact form. Many residences also offer immersive 3D tours to project yourself remotely.
FAQ.a6: Prepare the classics: ID, proof of schooling, and guarantor (tax notice, payslips). If you don't have a physical guarantor, we accept Visale or Garantme guarantees in most partner residences.
